rows.text: This fascinating and beautiful book is divided into broad geographical sections which celebrate and showcase the peoples, landscapes and wildlife from different regions of this great continent, and bright and bold illustrations bring these facts to life. Illustrations and cover art for Africana – An encyclopedia of an amazing continent, written by Kim Chakanetsa and published on 4 October 2022 by Wide Eyed Editions.

rows.text: NON-FUNGIBLE ADS Everything in these small businesses" ads was available for purchase: from the frames of their videos to their music, all using NFT technology. INSIGHT Meta Elevate is our program to help Black and LatinX entrepreneurs to grow. We provide free training, mentors, and partnerships. So we thought: what if instead of these small businesses paying for ads, the ads paid them back as NFTs? HOW IT WORKED We matched small businesses, NFT artists, and musicians to collaborate and create 15-second ads in the artists unique styles. The creators broke the videos down frame-by-frame and turned them into NFT collections. The profit was used to benefit the small businesses and the communities. AN OPEN-SOURCE IDEA As an open idea, any underserved community can use it now create ads that make profit. A new way to help elevate small businesses and creators. More than ever, ads pay off. 120k people engaged in the drop. The launch was simultaneous in NFT NYC (one of the worlds' most important NFT events); and on the stages of Cannes Lions, Creative Week Lisbon and Conecta Entertainment Fest in Spain. All NFTs were sold.

rows.alt: Three book covers by Rogba Payne: "The Dance of Shadows," "A Testimony of Blood," and "The Tribulation of Gods," featuring striking artwork with silhouettes and vibrant colors.
rows.text: Song of Godhunters is a project in which Mayowa Alabi painted all three book covers for Rogba Payne’s trilogy, published by Gollancz. Entrusted to bring the world of the series to life three times over, Alabi created each cover as part of one cohesive visual journey through the story. The project was made possible by the trust of Gollancz and Rachael Lancaster, and by Payne’s storytelling, which made the work a joy to paint.

The Beautiful Game is a collection that seeks to make football’s beauty visible, not just its competition. It reimagines fandom through the artist’s lens, portraying women in the jerseys of all 48 nations competing in the 2026 World Cup. Each portrait strips the sport back to something quieter and more intimate, presenting national pride as beauty, identity, and belonging rather than rivalry.
